tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get a short feature and limits summary. Request detail=full only for the complete reference. Does not start a timer.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List preset names, schedules and links without recipe bodies. Use get_preset(id) only when full steps or customization are needed.

tools.name: get_preset
tools.description: Get one preset with its full validated recipe. Use list_presets for quick recommendations; request details only to inspect or customize steps.

tools.name: create_clock_link
tools.description: Return a validated link to the next local clock time, e.g. 9pm or 17:30. Each opener uses their own timezone. This does not schedule a server timer.

tools.name: create_timer
tools.description: Validate a duration and return a link. The countdown starts when the person opens it, not when this tool runs. No background alarm or automation is scheduled.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description: Validate a data-only recipe and return its portable preview link. The person opens it and presses Start. No code runs and no webhook is armed.

tools.name: get_integrations
tools.description: Explain optional Zapier completion hooks, setup, authorization, and browser-lifetime limitations. Does not connect or send anything.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_integrations" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Explain optional Zapier completion hooks, setup, authorization, and browser-lifetime limitations. Does not connect or send anything.
